description: The caller's trading vaults, read from the chain: each with its vault venue row (venue_row: the row id and its path, vault, ack box, venue), what is in it, what is free, what is set aside as margin (each also in USD: usd), the mandate and who administers it; usd: every vault's value as one USD figure with the vault venue rows under it.
name: my_vaults
